steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Gate. Each contract needs a signed copy, a signature date and a note of any departure from the standard.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 2 contracts lack a signed copy or a date

findings.title: Contract with no signed copy
findings.fix: Find the signed copy or re-execute the contract

findings.title: Signature date missing
findings.fix: Record the date from the signed copy

findings.title: Departure from the standard not noted
findings.fix: Note the departure in the file

outcome.notChecked: Whether a contract is enforceable; the signature itself.
